name: Dexlansoprazole 60mg 7 Capsules Delayed Release Takeda
description: Dexlansoprazole is used to treat the symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD; a condition in which acid secreted by the stomach backs up into the esophagus, causing reflux and possible injury to the esophagus (the tube between the throat and stomach)) in adults and children 12 years and older. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
